component.name: Calepin
component.summary: Fast notes and text editing, with Markdown rendered as you type

description.p: Calepin is a small, native notepad for quick notes, reading and editing. Tabs are saved continuously, so nothing is lost when the window closes, even for notes never saved to a file.

ul.li: Markdown rendered as you type: headings, emphasis, lists, tasks, quotes, code, links and tables
Minimap with search results, smooth scrolling
Any text file opens in plain mode with syntax highlighting
Follows the desktop's light or dark style and accent colour, or the Omarchy theme

description.p: Buttons show the hand under the pointer, and the pointer keeps the right shape over the text while middle-click scrolling. Code blocks stand out more, and their ``` lines show only while the caret is in the block.
Middle-click scrolling works while the button is held (releasing stops it), as well as after a click.

Dragging across table cells no longer risks leaving the pointer held by a cell. Middle-click scrolling stops on any click, on a tab change or when the window loses focus, and over a wide table it also scrolls sideways.

Table cells can be selected together (drag, Shift+click, Shift+arrows), copied as tab-separated text, cleared, and filled by pasting. Columns resize by dragging their border; tables too wide for the window scroll sideways (Shift+wheel, swipe or scrollbar) and CSV columns keep their width.
Middle click scrolls fast (or pastes, from the right-click menu). The text cursor no longer turns into a hand over text, and a wide table can no longer make the window wider than the screen.

Folding: Markdown sections, JSON objects and arrays, YAML blocks. Arrows in the margin, a "⋯" on folded lines, keyboard shortcuts; folds are kept across undo and restarts, and folded text is still saved, copied and searched.
Dragging in the minimap keeps the visible band under the pointer, however long the document.

Undo history survives a restart. Ctrl+Z works from table cells (a new table is undone in one step), undoes a word at a time, puts the caret back at the change and reaches across the source view switch.
Long list items wrap under their text; the caret no longer lands before a bullet; tables no longer squeeze after the source view switch; quotes and secondary text stay readable in every theme.
CSV and TSV files open as an editable table and are saved back as CSV, keeping their separator and line endings.
Checks for updates every 6 hours while running, and retries when the network is not up yet. The version is shown under the minimap.

Ctrl+A in a table cell selects the cell, then the table, then the document. Tables inside a selection are drawn as selected. Fixed a crash when a table was removed with the pointer over it, and a blank line left behind by deleting a selected table.
New icon. English interface, in French when the locale is French. Markdown typed inside table cells now renders.
Start-up check for new releases, with in-place update when installed from source.
